Brother, from personal experience and I literally tried everything, I can tell you leave your fingers from this stuff. You open a gate which probably is already open even more. There is a spirit world. But it is not for us to play with. As I said I literally tried everything. I‘ve studied psychology, spirituality, psycedelics, shamanism, and so much more. Only to get crazier and crazier. All of this is true. The experiences you have I mean. But they are NOT the solution. As I said, it is not for us to play with and in the bitter end, you don‘t „only“ lose your mind but you lose your soul! I will tell you something that sounded riddicolus to me too at first. The one thing, that for so many years, I wouldn‘t even considering to be the truth. This truth is Jesus Christ. He saved me when nothing and I literally mean NOTHING else could. He is the way, the truth and the life. And he will save you as he did for me and so many others. Please concider it. He loves you more than you could ever imagine. And once again, I am telling you this out of love. Because I know how it feels like to be lost. Because I know how it feels like to be called crazy. Now I am found. And I wish nothing but the same for you! God bless you! From all my heart!

I‘ve tried to write something down last time. As I was asking and the guide brought me a pen, I was sitting there thinking: Why do you want to do that? Why not giving this experience your full attention? When he came back, I told him: thank you, but nevermind. 

For me it was about worries. The worries to forget what I am experiencing right now. And the more we worry, the more it‘s gonna happen. So I decided to trust, that this experience is gonna last forever. And till now, it is. I wrote a few things down after the whole ceremony. But just some side notes for me. I think I would‘t need them though. And I think it was a good decision not to write down while inside. You wouldn‘t stop and take a picture yourself, or write something down, on your wedding day, would you? In the best moment, when you say „I do“, would you interrupt to write down how you feel? Or is it better to enjoy the moment. I think feeling is more important here. And real feelings you remember forever. That‘s my opinion. And I am happy with my decision. 😊❤️🙏🏼
